claims.scope: BuyBackBurner V2 buyback-and-burn flow using UniswapPriceOracle price validation and BuyBackBurnerUniswap swap

preconditions.text: The BuyBackBurner contract holds secondTokens (e.g., ETH/WETH) waiting to be bought back into OLAS and burned.; In UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice(), the computed timeWeightedAverage is mathematically always equal to the current spot price tradePrice.; BuyBackBurnerUniswap._performSwap() sets amountOutMin = 0 for the V2 DEX swap.; buyBack is permissionless (anyone can call it), so the attacker can choose the optimal timing to maximize profit.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Inferred: validatePrice(maxSlippage) should reject a spot price that has been manipulated outside the allowed maxSlippage bound, so a buyback cannot complete using an inflated attacker-controlled price.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: In Block N, inside BuyBackBurner._buyOLAS, _performSwap swaps at amountOutMin = 0 at the inflated price, causing BuyBackBurner to receive far fewer OLAS than the fair market price.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The buyback flow calls UniswapPriceOracle.validatePrice(maxSlippage) before performing the swap.
The Uniswap V2 pool is the venue used by BuyBackBurnerUniswap._performSwap().
Any caller may invoke buyBack to trigger the buyback-and-burn path.
The swap consumes secondTokens held by BuyBackBurner and returns OLAS to the contract.

limitations: imp_after_swap_check_passes is a secondary consequence of the same TWAP identity flaw and is deferred from the core V.
Attacker capital and pre-existing OLAS/secondToken holdings before Block N-1 are outside this core binding.
Fee-on-transfer, gas, and bridge2Burner constraints on the attacker's profit are not modeled.
The concrete manipulated spot price and fair market price are not available, so the V is represented at the completion/forbidden-effect level rather than as a quantified slippage loss.
